observations: Stacks of used passenger car tires without rims.
Foreground stack shows about four to five tires; background shows many more stacked tires.
Some tires carry red and yellow chalk marks and one white sticker.
No sidewall brand, model, size, or DOT date code is legible in either photo.
Photos show only tread and outer sidewall; interior condition and air retention cannot be seen.

claims.evidence: Photos show used tires but cannot confirm import status or direct sourcing.

risks.risk: Remaining tread depth and usable life
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread with a depth gauge or coin alongside

risks.risk: Tire age and rubber condition (DOT date code)
risks.proof: Photo of the sidewall DOT stamp

risks.risk: Hidden punctures, repairs, or internal damage
risks.proof: Video of each tire inflated and held underwater or inspected

risks.risk: Condition and count of tires hidden in background stacks
risks.proof: Video panning across all stacks to show every tire
risks.if_unproven: only the visible foreground stack is priced

proof_requests: Close-up of sidewall showing size, brand, and DOT date code
Tread depth photo with gauge or coin
Video showing all stacks and any visible damage
Video of a tire being inflated to confirm it holds air
response.reason: The goods are identifiable as used passenger tires by type, so no model is required; they can be priced at worst case as untested, unknown-age used tires.
